description: This file defines an in-memory NotesRepository object providing CRUD operations and search functionality for Note objects within a notes app.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A singleton object acting as an in-memory repository for Note objects, supporting typical CRUD operations and search.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Returns all notes sorted by timestamp in descending order.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to the repository.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its id.

methods.name: deleteNoteById
methods.description: Removes a note based on its id.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Finds notes whose title or content matches the search query.
